page.notes: Transcribed as printed; the scan is faint in places. "quàin" in "hoc quàin statu" is doubtful and may be a printing error for "quàm in statu"; the word is marked [?] in the text below in the sense of a reading uncertainty. Running head shows "CAVSAS" with V as a consonant in capitals; given as CAUSAS per the vowel rule. Forms like "uiftus" and "fyncope" are read as "victus" and "syncope" from their long-s and ligature spelling. The small dot in the right margin is ink or stain, not text, and is left out. The reference mark "ę" after "syncope" and "afperfa" is the printed ę ligature, kept as printed. The catchword "crates" and the signature "I 5" are in the bottom margin.
